facts.business: Asian Granito India Limited (AGL) is one of India's leading integrated luxury surfaces and bathware companies, manufacturing ceramic tiles, glazed vitrified tiles, polished vitrified tiles, engineered marble, quartz, sanitaryware, faucets and bathware solutions for residential, commercial and institutional projects across India and international markets.
